tagline: 在无限画布上写、看、整理 Mermaid 图表
brief: An infinite-canvas previewer for Mermaid diagrams, rendered by Pele and saved in the browser. For developers and product people who think in diagrams. Black, white and grey only — the tones themselves separate the parts of the mark.
criteria: Success: reads as a diagram tool without drawing a flowchart, nods to the name without a cliché mermaid, recognisable at 16 px, works in one colour and in black / white / grey.

concepts.name: Branch Tail
concepts.idea: A decision node splits into two branches that flare into a mermaid's tail.
rationale: One sign for both halves of the name: the diagram (a decision and its branches) and the mermaid (the tail)
Black, graphite and silver separate node, yes-branch and no-branch; the order of contrast stays the same on dark
Softened corners on a strict diamond: friendly, still exact
A heavier small cut keeps the idea at 16–32 px; one-colour versions hold through the gaps

recommendation: Branch Tail in its softened cut, with Geist SemiBold for the wordmark — 'Mermaid' in ink, 'Preview' in graphite.
